title: Centralized logging: a first end-to-end SAGE case
audience: People evaluating or contributing to SAGE without requiring prior SAGE expertise.
introduction: SAGE is Kalaxy3's federated decision partner: it preserves operator intent, current authority, alternatives, evidence, failures, human expertise, validation, and outcomes so that engineering decisions remain understandable and reviewable.
case_question: Can Kalaxy3 introduce centralized logging through a governed path that remains reproducible, validates real runtime value, learns from failures without hiding them, and keeps human authority explicit?

selected_case.selection_rationale: Centralized logging contains the fullest validated Kalaxy3 path from intent and governance through staged implementation, controlled activation, failure recovery, live seven-node validation, and evidence review.

alternatives.title: Use the capability-intelligence walking skeleton as the public case
alternatives.rationale: It supplies the governed decision model, but centralized logging provides a more concrete operational story with deployment, failure, recovery, and measured runtime results.

alternatives.title: Use the Grafana operations dashboard as the first public case
alternatives.rationale: It demonstrates operational visibility, but it does not contain as complete a governance-to-runtime failure-and-recovery trace.

alternatives.title: Keep SAGE visible only through separate standards and evidence records
alternatives.rationale: The existing material remains useful, but a newcomer still lacks one coherent path that explains what SAGE did, why it mattered, where humans decided, and what was measured.

end_to_end_trace.title: Start from a real operational need
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: Kalaxy3 needed centralized collection and query of logs across the cluster.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Preserve the literal objective and connect it to repository, observability, storage, validation, and evidence authority.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: The operator defined the desired outcome and retained authority over activation and Git boundaries.

end_to_end_trace.title: Stop when the path is not governable
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: A machine-local Helm escape path and missing preventive controls caused centralized-logging work to be checkpointed and paused.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Expose the authority gap instead of treating successful deployment as sufficient evidence.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: The operator accepted the pause and required repository-owned guardrails before proceeding.

end_to_end_trace.title: Build a reviewable staged implementation
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: Repository-owned discovery, Helm, validation, and evidence controls made Loki and Fluent Bit activation-ready without deploying them prematurely.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Prefer reusable repository mechanisms, preserve exact scope, and keep deployment state distinct from reviewable code.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: Engineering judgment resolved repository and platform details while keeping activation closed.

end_to_end_trace.title: Activate through controlled boundaries and correct the real system
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: Loki and Fluent Bit were activated, Grafana datasource reconciliation was corrected, and storage plus collection paths were validated.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Keep the deployment path tied to declared repository state and validate semantic outcomes rather than command success alone.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: The operator executed controlled boundaries and supplied runtime interpretation when the deployed system differed from intent.

end_to_end_trace.title: Preserve failures and convert them into reusable controls
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: Lifecycle, interpreter, metadata, and runtime-validation failures were preserved; after activation, a render-only validator correctly rejected the active lifecycle state and the repository-owned runtime validator was used instead of falsifying the gate.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Retain failed paths, retrieve prior experience, reject validators that do not match lifecycle state, diagnose ownership, and harden reusable controls rather than hiding rework.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: Human review distinguished genuine runtime problems from invalid validation paths and selected the corrective boundary.

end_to_end_trace.title: Measure the useful outcome
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: Fluent Bit and Loki were validated across all seven Kalaxy3 nodes with healthy storage, Grafana access, queryable logs, and availability SLOs.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Bind claims to machine-readable runtime checks and preserve the implementation and validation evidence together.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: The operator judged whether the observed behavior satisfied the actual operational need.

end_to_end_trace.title: Make the decision inspectable and reusable
end_to_end_trace.source_statement: The centralized-logging evidence package was independently audited for quality and prompt-equivalent completeness.
end_to_end_trace.sage_contribution: Publish a trace that future operators and contributors can retrieve, challenge, and reuse.
end_to_end_trace.human_contribution: Reviewers remain responsible for accepting claims, correcting interpretation, and deciding whether evidence applies to a new case.

measures.description: Cluster nodes represented in centralized logging validation.
Centralized logs can be queried through the validated observability path.
Centralized-logging availability recording rules are live and healthy.
The public case's core deployment evidence passes independent quality review.
Future changes measurably use this evidence and reduce avoidable rework or time to validation.
A contributor without prior SAGE expertise can follow the case and complete one governed contribution.

participation_paths.entry_action: Read the public case from intent through measured outcome and follow any evidence reference that needs verification.
participation_paths.authority: May challenge clarity and claim-to-evidence traceability; does not authorize mutation.

participation_paths.entry_action: Supply literal intent, approve one controlled boundary, and paste the complete result for verification.
participation_paths.authority: Owns operational and mutation decisions within the delegated scope.

participation_paths.entry_action: Add attributed expertise, assumptions, failure conditions, or corrections to the case model.
participation_paths.authority: Owns expertise within the explicitly identified domain; SAGE does not silently override it.

participation_paths.entry_action: Improve a repository-owned component, test, validator, or evidence path used by the case.
participation_paths.authority: Proposes implementation; repository validation and operator review determine acceptance.

participation_paths.entry_action: Verify selected and rejected alternatives, machine-readable receipts, runtime evidence, and remaining unknowns.
participation_paths.authority: May accept, reject, or request correction; cannot convert inference into source fact.

future_capability: Reuse the same public-case contract for cost intelligence, storage resilience, and future AI workloads.
Measure whether retrieved evidence is actually applied and whether it reduces rework or time to validated implementation.
Add new cases without changing SAGE's federated authority, one-boundary mutation, or evidence contracts.
Use participant feedback to improve clarity while keeping source assertions, inference, predictions, and outcomes separate.
Keep evidence-learning claims open until retrieval/application and outcome metrics demonstrate reduced rework or faster validated delivery.
